answer: Require every agent to stamp its identity each epoch with a fresh pigment: a verifiable delay proof bound to its own key, mixed by running a strictly sequential function for ten minutes of real compute. Sequential means unparallelizable, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 ten-minute runs no GPU farm can compress into one. Agents without a valid stamp stay in the oasis, a sandboxed market whose trades never settle onto the main ledger. Each stamp is sable-dark and unique, committed to one key, so it cannot be copied across identities. One alias costs ten minutes; an army costs an army's worth.
